name: Blue-Green Curtain
dimensions: Length 560 mm; Width 560 mm; Thickness 50 mm; Weight 10 kg
summary: Ci ban hua (porcelain plaque painting) is a type of ornamental porcelain plaque decorated with overglaze or underglaze images of landscapes, portraits, flora and fauna and so on. This type of object emerged during the Ming dynasty and by the early 20th century had became a specialty in Jing
